description: Plan work that spans several tasks or sessions as a checklist file where every box names its evidence, then execute it task by task with clean pickup between sessions. Adapted from the pstack multi-phase plan playbook. Records user corrections and design calls as decision files in plans/decisions/ (adapted from tRPC vNext), so later agents keep the same choices. Use when asked to plan, write a plan, break work into tasks or phases, or continue, resume or pick up a plan in a new session. Also use when the user corrects an approach in a repo that has plans/decisions/.
